Requires Save to Sidebar and Spaces. State lives on the authenticated recipient's VM and is not an access grant or delivery receipt; no choice leaves this VM. Accepted records include a historical saved shortcode; read the artifact catalog for current membership. Absent and pending participation include fresh permission-filtered presentation metadata. A presentation lookup failure fails the request. Settled participation returns presentation: null. No profile metadata is persisted.Artifactsdaemon_artifacts_participation_updatePresent, accept, or ignore a received shared SpacePresent creates pending only if absent, preserving accepted and ignored choices. Accept requires the last-read revision, uses the existing WWW-backed save operation, and records accepted only after save succeeds. Ignore persists dismissal and never changes access or saved membership. No choice is reported to the owner. Repeated accepted requests do not save again, even after removal. Mutations finish if the caller disconnects; a save may have succeeded before a later error. Reload participation and the saved catalog after an uncertain response; never blindly retry. Revision conflicts return 409 participation_changed. Present returns fresh permission-filtered presentation metadata while pending; accepted and ignored results return presentation: null. A presentation lookup failure precedes the present mutation; present may reuse an edge admission from the last 15 s. Accept and ignore never require a presentation lookup, and accept always rechecks admission. No operation grants or revokes access.daemon_artifacts_placementMove a web artifact between Library and the sidebarAccepts local, V2 saved, and connection-shared web artifacts with their exact catalog artifact_ref and space_id. Connection-shared artifacts also require the connection feature gate. Atomically commits placement and sidebar order: spaces prepends, library removes, and repeating the current placement preserves order. Content, identity, capabilities, pinning, and recency are preserved. Returns the committed request as a receipt; consume the existing placement-scoped artifact and Navigation subscriptions and re-fetch tab order for current state. Stale or missing identity returns 409 artifact_changed; a full sidebar returns 400 sidebar_full. Malformed or unsupported references and malformed body fields return 400 invalid_params.
